plain_english_policy: The Alabama Prepaid Affordable College Tuition (PACT) Program allows residents to pre-pay college tuition for their designated beneficiaries. Here’s a simplified breakdown of the key points from the provided text:
policy_direction_if_enacted: 1. **Fund Distribution**: The PACT Trust Fund distributes 84% of its assets to various Alabama state institutions based on specific percentages, with each institution receiving a designated share (e.g., University of Alabama gets 33.14%, Auburn University gets 30.74%).
sponsorship_supports_position: The PACT Program is designed to provide financial support for higher education, which can be seen as a progressive measure aimed at making college more affordable and accessible.
evidence_quotes: Each state institution of higher education including any two-year school shall honor the contract of any beneficiary of a PACT contract who is admitted to such institution. Full tuition and fees shall be waived for any student in accordance with the provisions of the PACT contract.

The PACT Board shall also administer and pay from available funds the tuition of PACT beneficiaries who elect to attend private colleges or out-of-state institutions as provided for in the PACT contract.
